note: The search oracle: queries a person typed, and what the first hits must be. tools/src/gates/check-search-oracle.ts runs every case through the search box's ranking and through kb.mjs find, so both must answer. A case is `q` plus one or more of `top` (the first hit is one of these ids), `kind` or `band` with `n` (each of the first n hits, 3 when absent, is of that kind or band) and `within` (id → the rank it must be at or above). A missed query is recorded here first: add the case, see the gate go red, then fix the ranking or add a synonym through the kb-vocab skill. The rates over every page's own symptom text are the relevance fixtures' (tools/src/lib/search-relevance.test.ts, tools/src/kb/relevance.test.ts); this file holds the named queries.
